title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00125 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:15: L/o 13 joints 5 1/2" over-torqued DP
01:15 - 03:00: L/o 4 joints over-torqued 5 1/2" HWDP. Used manual tongs to break one of the connections.
03:00 - 03:15: Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Changed handling equipment for pulling diverter.
03:15 - 03:30: Performed TBT for n/d BOP
03:30 - 04:15: N/d diverter and pulled slickjoint.
04:15 - 04:45: Load shifted weight from tension system to BOP carrier.
04:45 - 05:30: Disconnected BOP tension system. Meanwhile disconnected BOP nt2 connector
05:30 - 05:45: Skidded BOP over to test stump
05:45 - 06:15: Removed scaffolding around HP-RISER. Meanwhile performed TBT for pulling HP-RISER
06:15 - 07:00: Pulled HP-RISER to drill floor. Installed master bushing.
07:00 - 07:15: Performed TBT for l/o HP-RISER to HTS and installing hatches in moonpool
07:15 - 07:30: L/o HP-RISER to HTS
07:30 - 09:00: Installed hatches in moonpool. Meanwhile cleaned and preserved slickjoint end of report continued reporting on f-99
